caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jar centered on a plain, light beige background. The jar is cylindrical with a slightly wider top and bottom, and features a thick rim at the opening. The main color of the jar is a muted grayish-brown, and it is decorated with horizontal blue bands near the top and bottom, as well as two wavy blue lines around the middle. There are no other objects or decorations present in the composition. The artist’s signature, "Geo. V. Vegelles," appears in cursive in the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Quart Stoneware Preserving Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
